text: Neuromaps annotations continuous — every vertex value like 0.42 −1.73 rather label like “precuneus.” turn plottable atlas regions, pipeline discretizes values bins. bin becomes region colored along spectral gradient low high values. pipeline reads annotation data, first checks whether vertex values integers floating-point: Integer values → treated parcellation. unique ID becomes region. Value 0 medial wall. binning. Floating-point values → treated continuous brain map. NaN vertices medial wall. Remaining values binned. detection automatic. parcellation map neuromaps (like Schaefer parcels), pipeline handle discrete regions without binning. n_bins controls many quantile bins continuous data split . NULL (default) uses Sturges’ rule auto-detect bin count. formula 1 + log2(n) n number valid (non-NaN) vertices, clamped range 5–20. fsaverage5 10,242 vertices per hemisphere, gives 1 + log2(10242) ≈ 14 bins. explicit integer overrides auto-detection. Use fewer bins cleaner, schematic look; bins finer spatial resolution. Bins created using quantile breaks, equal-width intervals. means bin contains approximately number vertices. Equal-width bins leave vertices central bins distribution skewed, common brain maps. Quantile binning ensures every bin contributes visible surface area atlas, making resulting plot informative regardless data distribution. Bins colored using HCL Spectral palette. Bin 1 (lowest values) gets cool end spectrum, last bin (highest values) gets warm end. medial wall always grey (#BEBEBE) labeled “unknown.”

what: Cerebellar atlas type and SUIT flatmap pipeline
title: ggseg.extra 1.9.9.9003
text: New “cerebellar” atlas type added across ggseg ecosystem (ggseg.formats, ggseg, ggseg3d). Cerebellar atlases use SUIT flatmap sf polygons 2D rendering per-region meshes 3D (like subcortical).
